scope: Evaluation-only coherent pilot/data relative phase inconsistency; not all natural phase errors. Global rotations do not trigger this definition. Exact per-model frame intervals; descriptive whole-frame paired bootstrap fixed-model mixture. Fewer than 20 observed events flagged as sparse, not a validation or decision threshold.

paired_frame_bootstrap.zero_event_scope: Degenerate empirical bootstrap does not imply zero population uncertainty. For an all-model zero-event mixture the frame-union one-sided bound is conservative; models are not independent replicates.
